name: degree_centrality
author: a018559c
description: Ranks nodes by their unweighted number of incident connections, breaking ties by node ID. For directed graphs it reports in-degree, out-degree, and their sum; it works with directed and undirected graphs and returns at most top_k labeled nodes.

graph_id.description: ID of the graph to analyse.

top_k.description: Maximum number of highest-degree nodes to return.
